questions.question: The edit is done, but every bash command on this host is refused ("bash sandbox requested but unavailable... Bubblewrap cannot create a namespace"), so I can't run `od -c settings.ini`. How do you want to handle the byte dump?

options.label: Leave it — I'll run od myself
options.description: No settings change; I report the edit and the file's current content only.

options.label: Propose turning off the bash sandbox
options.description: Set [sandbox] bash = "off" via the settings prompt, then I rerun od. This removes the sandbox boundary; the container/host is then the only isolation.
